summary.plain: The JUNO collaboration's initial report on how well the detector itself works: how much light it collects, how sharply it measures energy, and how clear its liquid scintillator is.
summary.technical: Initial performance results for the JUNO central detector: liquid-scintillator attenuation length 20.6 m at 430 nm; about 1785 photoelectrons per MeV at the detector centre; energy resolution 3.4% for two 0.511 MeV gamma rays at the detector centre; energy nonlinearity calibrated to better than 1%; data-acquisition duty cycle above 97.8% during the initial science runs.

title: Initial performance results of the JUNO detector

why_it_matters.quote: During the initial science runs, the data acquisition duty cycle exceeded 97.8%, demonstrating the excellent stability and readiness of JUNO for high-precision neutrino physics.
why_it_matters.value: The abstract reports a data-acquisition duty cycle above 97.8% during the initial science runs, which it says demonstrates the excellent stability and readiness of JUNO for high-precision neutrino physics; IHEP's news item says early data show the key performance indicators fully meet or surpass design expectations.
